findings.title: Feature-to-table references include aliases and an omitted local-only schema table
findings.finding: 22 initial references do not resolve to the87-table map. meeting_guests, person_commitments and phase_assessments are wrong or historical aliases; annotation/wildcard strings are mixed into exact IDs. communication_failed_retries is a real localb3 table independently confirmed atsrc/db/schema/communication.ts244, so the database source union must include it rather than removing the capability reference.
findings.required_fix: Include everylocalb3 declared table in the source union; use declared canonical names; move scope annotations/wildcards to notes; validate exact capability.tables against the map and separately type operational system-catalog references.
findings.resolution: The central registry uses canonical table identifiers and separate operational catalog/scope notes. The real local failed-retry table is included. All 84 current-source declarations and four historical tables have dispositions and feature links; no exact table reference is unresolved.

findings.title: Acceptance IDs repeat and obscure feature-specific traceability
findings.finding: Initial registry664 rows contains219 duplicate IDs, all repeated shared Evry gates. A keyed consumer silently overwrites feature obligations.
findings.required_fix: Keep each AC-EVR-### unique and define each shared gate once with feature_ids/parameterized case linkage, or separate shared_gate_refs from per-feature acceptance records.
findings.resolution: All 720 parameterized acceptance IDs are unique. Shared gate labels remain explicit metadata, and each of 496 capability records resolves to its own acceptance binding.

findings.title: Historical credential helpers appear as proposed public domain operations
findings.finding: The target operations include identity.hashToken, createSession, setSessionCookie and verifySession as though each historical exported function were a product contract, while ADR-003 replaces credential/session ownership with Better Auth.
findings.required_fix: Distinguish source/internal symbols from target public operations. Publish stable product operations login/logout/recover/changeCredentials and document Better Auth adapters/internal support without promising old helper API parity.
findings.resolution: IDN-001 publishes auth.signIn/auth.signOut/auth.getSession. Historical credential helpers are source evidence; Better Auth owns credential/session mechanics. The new API contract document distinguishes public product operations from internal support symbols.

findings.title: Auth recovery and invitation packages lack an early complete mail boundary
findings.finding: WP-005 andWP-008 depend on jobs but the provider send/suppression/idempotency boundary is only specified inWP-028, which follows meeting/composition. The first runnable auth slice cannot meet mailbox recovery/invitation delivery gates unlessWP-031 explicitly delivers that boundary.
findings.required_fix: Move minimal transactional mail dispatch/template/provider/suppression guarantees into an early package depended on by auth/invites; retain composition/bulk/webhook specialization in later communication packages. Avoid introducing a cycle.
findings.resolution: WP-031 supplies early transactional mail, protected auth templates, suppression and provider idempotency. NTF-013 maps to WP-031, while auth/invitation packages consume it and later communication packages own composition/bulk specialization.

findings.title: Evry ownership and contract-freeze definitions disagree with the root architecture
findings.finding: Evry uses apps/api/src/modules for domain ownership, an old WP-evry placeholder, advisoryEVRY-01..08 IDs and differentC1/C2/C3 meanings. Root assigns packages/domain/packages/evry andWP-051..055. Independent lane implementation would create duplicate canonical handlers/contracts.
findings.required_fix: Use one canonical ownership tree, root package/subpackage crosswalk and one freeze registry. Make advisory subdivision status explicit or add actual children to the machine-readable DAG.
findings.resolution: Evry now follows packages/domain and packages/evry ownership, root C0-C3 freezes and the actual 051-086 package DAG. EVRY-01-08 labels are explicitly advisory breakdowns, not a competing implementation sequence.

findings.title: Late all-feature Evry adapter packages are too broad to be small reviewable work units
findings.finding: WP-052 has112 features andWP-053123, each estimated3 days with all-domain fan-in. Even thin adapters need per-operation denied/stale/crash fixtures. This concentrates parity discovery late and understates evaluation/QA ownership.
findings.required_fix: Split stable per-module adapter/fixture subpackages with domain-lane prerequisites, integrate a read and reviewed-command vertical slice early, and re-estimate full assistant parity/evaluation effort. Document reviewer/QA capacity separately.
findings.resolution: Shared read/approval kernels precede28 module read/write delivery batches. They may be implemented together or combined by domain using shared registration and evaluation patterns; they do not imply 28 installed runtime adapters or packages. S1 includes an early assistant read/reviewed-write slice. Resource estimates are explicitly human assumptions and require measurement after the spike.

findings.title: The72-hour planter-first fallback needs an explicit discoverable decision
findings.finding: Source permits oversight release after72 hours without a planter opening. The feature record correctly asks for explicit v3 confirmation, but the open-decision register lacks a named row and its dependent package cannot locate the ruling.
findings.required_fix: Add or extend a named OD with preserved current72-hour behavior, literal planter-sees-first tension, decision owner andWP-044/047 gate. Do not silently change the accepted repository rule.
findings.resolution: OD-016 names the seen-or-72-hour release rule, SME/product/privacy ownership andWP-044/047 gates. The current accepted repository policy remains evidence; literal planter-first intent is not silently rewritten.

findings.title: Meetings/team module incorrectly summarizes manually installed self-foreign keys as absent
findings.finding: The module says reportsTo(noFK)/reportsToRole(noFK), while the database audit correctly identifies manual0013 FKs absent only from TypeScript/snapshots.
findings.required_fix: Qualify declaration drift rather than absent physical integrity; preserve both evidence sources and avoid claiming the live catalog was inspected.
findings.resolution: Module tables now qualify the manually installed self-FKs as absent from TypeScript/snapshots rather than nonexistent. The database map preserves source drift without claiming a live catalog inspection.

findings.title: The first operational vertical slice omits a required earlier team package
findings.finding: The initial operational slice omitted its team prerequisite. After adding that prerequisite and early account-person linking, independent closure checks also identified settings/admin/ops omissions. The final cumulative slice lists account for every dependency.
findings.required_fix: Publish runnable cumulative sliceclosures:WP-011toS0,WP-010beforeS3,WP-049/050beforeS4platformadapters,or explicitlylist eachslice transitiveclosure. Re-runclosurecheck.
findings.resolution: All six published vertical slices have explicit cumulative package lists in the machine DAG and passed independent prerequisite closure. S0 includes settings/People/bootstrap operations; S1 includes early Evry kernels/adapters; admin dependencies precede full platform tools.

findings.title: Do not turn exhaustive traceability into a duplicated assistant architecture
findings.finding: A literal interpretation of 86 work packages, 28 assistant adapter batches and 255 historical/local assistant records would recreate a service/tool/registration burden the rebuild intends to remove. An exhaustive source inventory is not the recommended public API or runtime architecture. The 66-day estimate also needed an explicit human-duration/resource basis rather than an implication about agent throughput.
findings.required_fix: Publish a complexity budget and a many-to-one source-to-target operation crosswalk; allow adjacent delivery units and read/write adapters to consolidate while retaining variant-specific permissions and acceptance. State recurring separate-backend costs and human effort/duration assumptions. Make simplification an implementation gate.
findings.resolution: The complexity budget explicitly limits the leading shape to web/API deployables with an optional worker process, shared domain folders/handlers, one credential/mail/storage/jobs/assistant owner and no generic workflow or service fleet. Source surfaces can map to direct, alias, internal-support, replaced-mechanism or needs-decision dispositions with typed variants. The 28 adapter entries are combinable review batches, not 28 runtime packages. Executive text names SSR/auth/proxy/stream/deployment/toolchain/observability costs, treats Elysia familiarity and modular Next as real alternatives, and separates 222 human engineer-days from the 66-working-day unrestricted prerequisite lower bound and agent throughput. C0/runtime and first-slice complexity review remains a future gate.
